_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#1 (u.Other() is the only neighbour accessor; the miss names ProxyFunction, not 'trial function'). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, L2 order 1 dgjumps=True: type(u) really is ngsolve.comp.ProxyFunction, u.neighbour raises AttributeError whose text contains the class name and "has no attribute 'neighbour'", and the phrase the claim says is never emitted ('trial function has no attribute neighbour') is indeed absent from it. None of neighbour/neighbor/Neighbour/Neighbor/other exists on the object; Other does. A form built from 0.5*(u+u.Other()) over dx(skeleton=True) assembles to 756 non-zeros against 216 for the element-local mass matrix on the plain L2 space, so Other() genuinely couples across facets. Mutation: replacing u.neighbour by u.Other in the probe removes the AttributeError and the fixture fails on neighbour_raises_attributeerror.
